result.title: Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
result.summary: Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging. Leveraging pretrained vision-language models offers a way to build on already learned multimodal knowledge, but making this knowledge effectively accessible to visual generation remains nontrivial. We find that a central challenge lies in the heterogeneous visual representations used for understanding and generation. To address this challenge, we introduce Integral, which converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space across the two capabilities. Integral implements this design through two complementary components. Abstraction Fusion constructs shared visual tokens by aggregating hierarchical representations from the frozen vision encoder, while Block-wise MoT introduces a lightweight generative stream that interacts with the vision-language model only at block boundaries. Our approach effectively preserves the pretrained understanding capability while extending it to strong visual generation. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that sharing visual representations between understanding and generation substantially improves generative learning compared with using a separate visual representation space, despite comparable reconstruction fidelity. These results suggest that representations learned by pretrained vision-language models already provide an effective foundation for visual generation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Integral：用 Abstraction Fusion 聚合冻结视觉编码器的层级表示形成共享视觉 token，并引入仅在 block 边界与 VLM 交互的轻量生成流 Block-wise MoT，把预训练 VLM 扩展为统一理解-生成模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其共享视觉表示空间与层级特征聚合可供核查 VLM 内部状态是否保留足够的视觉细节，block 边界接口也可能类比 LVR 中视觉旁路或信息坍缩的瓶颈，但论文目标是图像生成，未涉及 latent 推理。
